about: The two variables PDF Manager hands a Quotes template, shaped as Sugar 26.1 builds them: 'fields' from PdfManagerHelper::parseBeanFields(quote) with SugarpdfPdfmanager::preDisplay's own rewrites (date_quote_expected_closed in the user's date format, ext_price as discount_price x quantity with the currency symbol), and 'product_bundles' with every quoted line item parsed the same way.
parseBeanFields turns a currency field into '$22.81' (symbol, then the user's separators), a decimal into '2.00', runs nl2br over a string and leaves out a field whose value is null.

Shaped like the live QA quote whose Epicor quote is 8890: line 1 is 20498P04W x 2 with a three-rung Kinetic price ladder (1 @ 24, 10 @ 22, 50 @ 20), line 2 is 20498P07W x 3 with one rung; 4 quoted line items in all, 22.81 a unit on both lines, Expires printed '2026-11-21' by a Y-m-d user (read off that quote's PDF and its run log).

Each rung is its own quoted line item. The connector keys it '<company>__<QuoteNum>_<QuoteLine>_<QtyNum>' and does not write erp_ladder_group (the field a copied quote carries once its key is shed), so a synced rung has no erp_ladder_group at all: recorded in erp-integration-core tests/unit/fixtures/quote_line_delivery_calls.json (ADM__6001_1_1..4) and module_several_records_1016.json (PILOT__1016_1_1 and _1_2, erp_ladder_group None).
The two rungs the seller did not choose carry erp_total_role 'alternative' (ERP-Epicor's ErpLineRole), which is why the live PDF printed two lines from four items.

Line 1's rungs 2 and 3 sit after line 2, as rungs the sync adds after the seller made both lines would. Line 1 carries a long description (e_line_comment_c, the customer's own field for Kinetic's line comment, with Kinetic's carriage-return line breaks after nl2br). Names, addresses and people are neutral test values.
